name: Perceived Restorativeness of Streetscapes (Guangzhou Liwan)
description: Method replication: the images are new Baidu street views of Liwan District, Guangzhou, taken like the paper's (one of four directions, about 90° field of view, 640×360), not the paper's stimuli. Each participant rates 20 random street views on the eight statements of the revised Perceived Restorativeness Scale (fascination, being away, compatibility, extent; two statements each) from 1 (strongly disagree) to 5 (strongly agree), as in Kang, Kang & Wang (2025, Buildings). The paper removed responses with less than 15 s per image or identical ratings for every image. Differences from the original study: the statements are shown in English; a professional-background question is kept from the paper's professional vs non-professional comparison.
author: Kang, Kang & Wang
